title: Evaluate your agent
subtitle: Pick your agent, say what you want to learn, choose benchmarks, and get one report card.

agent.heading: Which agent do you want to test?
agent.hint: Pick one of your agents or a built-in one. Each card shows what the agent can do.
agent.noneYours: You have not registered an agent yet.
agent.registerHint: Start from a template (CLI, HTTP endpoint, framework). You come back here after.
agent.noVersions: No saved versions yet. The current config is used.

learn.heading: What do you want to learn?
learn.hint: This decides how many setups run side by side.

modeHelp.score: Run your agent once per task and get a report card of how well it does.
modeHelp.versions: Run two saved versions of your agent on the same tasks and see which is better.
modeHelp.models: Run your agent with two different models and see which model helps it more.
modeHelp.opponent: Run your agent and a well-known agent on the same tasks and compare them.

learn.needTwoVersions: This agent has fewer than two saved versions. Save a change to the agent to make a second one.
learn.sameVersion: Pick a different version than the one in step 1.
learn.modelsLater: You choose the two models in step 4.
